title: Authority boundaries
summary: The allocator decides execution-node placement but does not absorb neighbouring authorities. Security/Legal/Access decisions are hard eligibility evidence; WLU owns work-capacity reservation; Queue Fabric owns transport; API Client owns outbound egress session allocation; Crypto supplies digest/proof primitives through existing interfaces.
invariants: Queue delivery is not placement authority.
A WLU reservation is authoritative capacity admission, not a scheduler score.
API egress selection may legitimately occur after general execution-node placement.
